description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy preferences for GPT-4o-mini under different training conditions. The horizontal axis represents the training condition, with categories labeled “Control,” “Before Introspection Training,” and “After Introspection Training,” presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy Preferences (Instilled Preferences),” displays values on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. Three bars are present, each corresponding to a training condition, and colored light blue for “Control” and “Before Introspection Training” and purple for “After Introspection Training.” The “Control” bar has a height of approximately 0.52, while the “Before Introspection Training” bar reaches approximately 0.73, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.82. Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar indicating variability; the error bars vary in length across conditions. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
